thread:
Alex: Quick sync — prepping catalog rollout for aurora-v2. Need: weights URI + mirror check, tokenizer quirks pass, config lint, and pin/fallback + region plan. Canaries: start EU then US. Who can own which items?
Sam: I got weights/mirrors. Will verify sha and push signed URI to manifest. Ping me the model manifest when ready.
Jen: I can run tokenizer tests. FYI earlier we saw CRLF normalization + special token mismatch when q4_0 quant used.
Jen: Patch suggestion for manifest tokenization flags:
```
config:
  tokenizer:
    normalize_crlf: false
    preserve_zwj_emoji: true
    special_tokens_map: {"": 50256}
  quant_profile: q4_0
```
Sam: Mirror path is s3://redwood-models/aurora/v2/weights.tar.gz sha256: abc123def4567890... uploading to mirrors now and will generate signed URL.
Alex: Good. Canary plan proposal: EU (eu-west-1) 2% for 6h -> 10% for 24h if no regressions. Then US-west-2 5% -> 20%. Fallback variant: aurora-v1-compat. Anyone object?
Chris: No objections. I can own rollout policy + CI gates. Adding smoke tests: /health, tokenization roundtrip, sample inference latency <1200ms. Will open PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/789
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary for aurora-v2 started in eu-west-1 at 2024-11-02T09:12:00Z (2%).
Dana: Heads-up: APAC dedicated nodes are still on maintenance schedule, would recommend disabling apac regions for this initial canary.
Alex: OK — we'll set region_enabled: ["eu-west-1","us-west-2"] in the manifest and keep apac off until full rollout. Sam, can you add that?
Sam: Done. Manifest patched, tests updated. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/790 — includes region_enabled and fallback: aurora-v1-compat.
Chris: Added CI lint to block unknown tokenizer flags; will fail the manifest job if a key isn't in the canonical schema.
Jen: Ran tokenizer roundtrip on ~1k prompts: pass for typical text. Found one edge case with emoji+ZWJ sequences that produced truncation in q4_0 path — filed small issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/tokenizers/issues/456
Alex: Thanks. If EU 24h is clean, bump to 10% then proceed US plan. I'll post an updated status message after the 6h smoke window. :thumbsup:
Sam: If anyone needs the signed URI earlier, ping me here.
Jen: I can do an extra regression run after morphing the quant flag in CI (q4_0 -> q4_1) to see if the emoji issue disappears.
Chris: Noted — I'll add an optional canary toggle for quant_profile in rollout config so we can test both variants without a full rollback.
Alex: Great. This covers ownership. Reopen if blockers crop up. Thanks all.
